title: Depth pass: Keystone, Rabby, Rainbow zero-history gaps
notes: Existing entities/products only. Adds material first-party lifecycle/security events without inventing unsupported product launch fields or routine version churn.

events.title: Cobo Vault rebranded as Keystone
events.description: Keystone's official support documentation states that Cobo Vault was rebranded as Keystone on June 1, 2021 after the original hardware-wallet team left Cobo to create Keystone.
events.notes: The historical Cobo Vault hardware products are not yet canonical WLR products, so this entity-level continuity event intentionally has no affected_product_ids.

events.title: Keystone 3 Pro publicly introduced in official product design article
events.description: Keystone published its official Keystone 3 Pro product-design article as part of the 2023 Keystone 3 rollout chronology following the July forthcoming-launch announcement.
events.notes: This is an introduction/announcement anchor, not an asserted exact retail availability date.

events.title: Rabby browser-extension wallet introduced
events.description: The Rabby/DeBank team publicly introduced Rabby as a browser-extension wallet for DeFi users on July 26, 2021.

events.title: Rainbow Extension v1.2.39 added signature-security hardening
events.description: Rainbow Extension v1.2.39 deprecated support for dApps relying on the vulnerable eth_sign signing method and added sanitization of EIP-712 signature-request fields to mitigate common phishing attacks.
events.notes: This records a material security-hardening release, not a claim that a specific exploited Rainbow vulnerability existed.

evidence.title: Cobo Vault Companion App
evidence.notes: Primary Keystone documentation explicitly states that Cobo Vault was rebranded as Keystone on June 1, 2021 and explains the original team's continuity.

evidence.title: Keystone Wallet — Deep Dive into Keystone chronology
evidence.notes: Current official Keystone site lists the July 7, 2023 forthcoming Keystone 3 launch article and the September 4, 2023 Keystone 3 Pro product-design article in its first-party chronology.

evidence.title: Rabby Release Announcement
evidence.notes: First-party Rabby publication introducing the new browser-extension wallet on July 26, 2021.

evidence.title: Bridging and Testnets — Rainbow Extension v1.2.39
evidence.notes: Primary Rainbow release notes documenting eth_sign deprecation and EIP-712 field sanitization in v1.2.39.
